title: weighted round robin: weight 1:2 dispatch ratio, no pool/command oversubscription, no starvation

fixed_configuration.method: P=1 makes completion order equal dispatch order; sample after 30 completions
fixed_configuration.startup_transient: first 30 dispatches excluded from the complete-round check

tolerance: empirical: ratio in [1.5,2.5] and |count2-2*count1|<=8; frozen in this manifest
